title: RSIPO: Recursive Self-Improving Policy Optimization for Agentic Reinforcement Learning via Skill-Policy Co-Evolution
organization: CUHK / Tsinghua University / NUS / Tongji University / UW-Madison / Westlake University / Shanghai AI Laboratory / Peking University
baseline: GRPO / GRPO+OPSD / SEED；需分别计入SFT、技能生成、重放与教师评分成本
mechanisms: Outcome-independent equal evidence/control split and exact-initial-state skill replay
Task-type empirical-Bayes gain shrinkage for teacher trust
On-policy skill generation reward combined with RLVR and trust-weighted OPSD
